A mule (donkey sire x horse mare), a real hybrid animal. Horse-sized body with deep chest, long back, long neck and horse proportions, with the donkey's long ears, short thick head, short upright mane, thin legs, small hooves and tufted tail; plain coat, no stripes or spots. Head fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Bilaterally symmetrical, recognizable limbs and visible sense organs. Prosaic detail: natural lighting, feet in firm contact with the ground with a soft shadow, normal wear on hooves, claws and skin. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
Aspect ratio: 1:1.
